title: DUT-AI True SSO JWT Claims and Cookie Specification
description: Standardized JWT claims issued by dut-ai-manager (IdP) and verified in-memory by dut-ai-quiz and meetly (Resource Servers).

sub.description: Unique user identifier across all DUT-AI services

iat.description: Epoch timestamp when the token was issued

exp.description: Epoch timestamp when the token expires (default: 7 days)

access_token.description: Name of the HTTP-only cookie holding the JWT

refresh_token.description: Name of the HTTP-only cookie holding the refresh token

domain.description: Wildcard parent domain allowing cookies to be sent to workspace.dutai.io.vn and all subdomains

path.description: Root path to ensure cookie is available across /manage, /lms, and /meetly

httpOnly.description: Prevents client-side script access for XSS protection

secure.description: Forces transmission only over HTTPS connections

sameSite.description: Permits top-level cross-subdomain navigations while guarding against CSRF
